# HTML Metadata

## Summary
A structural census of an HTML document rather than its text.

## Shape
Counts what the parse found — elements, words, headings, links, images, form controls, scripts,
stylesheets and external resources — plus the flags that decide how the preview should behave:
`hasDoctype`, `hasViewportMeta`, `hasInlineScript`, `hasModuleScript` and `isInteractive`, with
`interactivityLabel` computed for display. Those flags matter because the HTML preview is
sandboxed: whether a document is inert or wants to execute changes how it is framed.

## Example
```ts
import { HtmlMetadataField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(HtmlMetadataField);
```
